title: ₱13.6M shabu seized in Lapu-Lapu, Talisay anti-drug operations

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than ₱13.6 million worth of suspected shabu was seized and nine individuals were arrested in two separate anti-illegal drug operations in Lapu-Lapu City and Talisay City on Thursday, October 1. The two operations were conducted by the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office 7 (PDEA-7) and local police units.
